steps.name: s0-leaf
argv: Pass 1 of 2, seed 20260811. THE LEAF FILL, RE-RUN WITH THE GLOW BANNED. Same init, same ellipse 378,655,48,54, same strength/steps/cfg/pad/blur and the same four seeds as ep2-b01-leafcount-inpaint-0811; ONLY the two prompt files change. That round removed the third blade correctly and filled the hole with a pale bulb and a small bright disc instead of grass -- looked at, not inferred. `warm low sunlight` is out of the fill prompt (in a 96x108 crop the model drew the light SOURCE) and eleven glow terms are in the negative. PROVISIONAL: not a pick, not canon, not published, not assembled.

steps.name: s0-fig
argv:

src = r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\out-figmatte\b01-figmatte-s0-leaf.png"

sys.exit(subprocess.call([
    r"C:\banyan-farm\venv\Scripts\python.exe", r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\inpaint_fruit.py",
    "--init", src, "--init-sha256", h,
    "--ellipse", "462,848,34,36",
    "--prompt-file", r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\prompt-r2.txt",
    "--negative-file", r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\negative-r2.txt",
    "--out", r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\out-figmatte\b01-figmatte-s0.png",
    "--steps", "40", "--cfg", "7.5", "--strength", "0.99",
    "--seed", "20260811", "--pad-crop", "64", "--blur", "8",
    "--note", "Pass 2 of 2, seed 20260811. THE FIG, MATTE. ]))

steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b01-figmatte"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/fig-inpaint/out-figmatte/b01-figmatte-s*.*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    # Hash the COPY: what this records has to be the bytes that get committed.
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
    print("   ", os.path.basename(f), h[:16])
# newline="\n" is load-bearing: Windows text mode would leave a trailing \r on
# every filename and shasum -c could not open them.
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b01-figmatte.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
# 4 seeds x 2 passes x (png + mask png + sidecar) = 24. Fewer means the round
# wrote less than it promised.
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) == 24 else 1)
